metadata.case_name: LAM CHUN KEUNG v. MOTOKI YOSHITAKA AND ANOTHER

source: The injuries suffered by the plaintiff involved lacerations to the head and some abrasions on his arms.
injuries.icd_description: Laceration without foreign body of head

source: The injuries suffered by the plaintiff involved lacerations to the head and some abrasions on his arms.
injuries.icd_description: Abrasion of other or unspecified parts of forearm

injuries.description: personality deterioration as a result of the injuries
source: A Medical Board convened at this hospital has found that the plaintiff has suffered a personality deterioration as a result of the injuries he received.

manifestations.description: rendered unconscious for a period of four weeks
His memory and ability to learn have been grossly impaired
His mental age was found to be that of a 9 year old child
has been unable to resume any form of employment since the date of the accident
an assessment of 85% total damage was arrived at

treatments_received: rendered unconscious for a period of four weeks and was finally discharged from hospital in March 1970
Medical Board assessment at Castle Peak Hospital
treatments_future: institutional care / constant supervision (as described by Dr. W.K. Lau)

losses.description: His memory and ability to learn have been grossly impaired and an assessment of 85% total damage was arrived at.
He would require constant supervision and ... it is inevitable that the plaintiff will spend the rest of his life in Castle Peak Hospital or some similar institution.
He has been unable to resume any form of employment since the date of the accident.
Unlike the claimants in both the cases cited this plaintiff does not enjoy the comforts of residing at his own home in the company of family members and it is almost certain that he never will.

comparable_cases.injury_description: the plaintiff, a 48 year old male, suffered a personality change as a result of injuries to his head. He became violent on occasions and required constant supervision and possibly eventual institutional care.

the plaintiff a 24 year old woman, suffered injuries in an accident including a fractured skull. This injury resulted in a significant intellectual impairment. She was unable to look after herself and was incapable of doing more than looking at comics or watching television.
